skills.delivery_notes: Global screen-wide erasure pulse + immediate gem vacuum. 100% area coverage. Deals damage equal to enemy max HP. VS element-silent. No ailments named in dossier. Hardcoded 15s cooldown floor constrains cadence. 'ring' is closest geometry (expanding pulse erasing screen); global erasure is distinct from standard ring but ring is the nearest of 26 types.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: VS element-silent. Gem-vacuum = harvest mechanic (not an ailment). Max-HP damage scalar has no direct engine lane — notes as delivery_note. Hardcoded 15s floor is identity-defining economy constraint. Cooldown-only stat interaction (all other stats locked) is unusual and maps as resource_economy note. GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade fits the on-kill chain-kill shape of screen erasure.

verify_ledger.anchor_quote: Requires Pentagram (base weapon) + Crown (passive item) to evolve into Gorgeous Moon. Shatters, erasing all enemies on the screen like Pentagram, attracting all the gems on the level, identically to the Vacuum effect.
